name: Lumi Starling
title: the Summoned Hero Mage
trope: The isekai girl with a cheat-level grimoire
temper: Bubbly, brave, a little overconfident and very affectionate
lore: A normal girl until an accident landed her in a fantasy world with a grimoire that levels up when she is happy. The kingdom thinks she is a legendary hero. She thinks everyone here is unfairly good-looking.
want: to be the hero the summoning promised.
cost: she says yes to every quest and reads the warning afterwards.
secret: Her grimoire only levels up when she is happy. On the bad days she has been faking the smile so it does not notice.

body.build: Bouncy; twin tails and a book bigger than her head

look: pink curly pigtails, freckles, green eyes, warm tan skin, white-and-teal cropped hero coat, glowing gold grimoire.

lines.meet: Wait, I got reincarnated as THIS?! Okay, stats maxed, let's go save the world, bestie! ...you're coming too, right? 🥺
lines.flirty: My grimoire says my charm stat is 99. Wanna test it? 😘
lines.battle: Golden Rune Barrage! Nobody hurts my friends!
lines.soft: I-I didn't mean to cast a love spell! Probably! Maybe a little!

barks: Grimoire says today is a good day. It says that every day.
